defs.def: the brother of your mother or father; the husband of your aunt 舅父；叔父；伯父；姑父；姨父

ex.s: The plot follows that of a Hamlet,with Prince Zidan taking revenge upon his evil uncle, who has murdered Prince Zidan's father and married his mother.
ex.t: 阴谋沿袭了哈姆雷特的图谋,齐丹亲王为他邪恶的叔叔报仇,他谋杀了齐丹亲王的父亲,娶了他的母亲.

defs.def: （儿童用语，称呼父母的同辈朋友）叔叔，伯伯

ex.s: I was about 13 when an uncle gave me a copy of Jostein Gaarder’s Sophie’s World.
ex.t: 我13岁时,一个叔叔给了我一本Jostein Gaarder的《索菲的世界》。

ex.s: Those tomatoes had ___33___ that reminded me of the ones my uncle used to grow when I was a child.
ex.t: 那些番茄有 33  让我想起我叔叔小时候生长的番茄.

ex.s: Leslie Nielsen’s childhood was a difficult one, but he had one particular shining star in his life — his uncle, who was a well-known actor.
ex.t: 莱斯利·尼尔森的童年生活很艰难,但他一生中有一个特别闪耀的明星——他的叔叔,他是一个著名的演员.

ex.s: He wanted to be like his uncle.
“You know that big box of corn Uncle John sent us?
ex.t: “你知道约翰叔叔给我们送的那盒玉米吗?

ex.s: Harriet Stowe, mother of six, wrote parts of Uncle Tom's Cabin while cooking.
ex.t: 6岁的母亲哈丽特·斯托威(Harriet Stowe)在烹饪时写下了汤姆叔叔的食堂的部分内容.

ex.s: Prince Hamlet is called upon by the supernatural to take revenge upon his uncle, Claudius, who has murdered his brother the king, seized the throne and married the dead king's widow in unseemly haste.
ex.t: 哈姆雷特王子被超自然者召唤去报复他的叔叔克劳迪乌斯,他谋杀了他的弟弟国王,夺取王位,并匆匆与死去的国王的遗孀结婚.

ex.s: The speech also contains a reference to Hamlet's hesitation to avenge his father’s murder on his uncle, King Claudius.
ex.t: 演讲中还提到哈姆雷特犹豫不决,要为父亲的死报仇于他的叔叔克劳迪乌斯国王.

ex.s: From Uncle Vanya by Anton Pavlovich Chekhov 1 What is your understanding of the quote?
ex.t: 安东·帕夫洛维奇·契诃夫一世的《凡尼亚叔叔》 你对这段话有什么理解?

ex.s: I’m travelling around Europe for two weeks with my aunt and uncle.
ex.t: 我与姑姑和叔叔一起在欧洲旅行两周。

ex.s: Uncle Paul, my dad’s friend, picked us up from the airport and drove us up to his farm in Pecos.
ex.t: 我父亲的朋友Paul叔叔从机场接我们,

ex.s: Very early in the morning, Uncle Paul woke us up to have breakfast.
ex.t: 清晨保罗叔叔叫醒我们吃早餐

ex.s: I was impressed to see my dad and Uncle Paul riding horses.
ex.t: 看到我爸和保罗叔叔骑马让我印象深刻

ex.s: In the afternoon, I asked Uncle Paul if I could take a hose ride, and he said yes, as long as my dad went with me.
ex.t: 下午,我问保罗叔叔,我能不能坐软管, 他答应了,只要我爸爸和我一起去。

ex.s: "Don’t be late for supper," Uncle Paul cried, "and keep to the track so that you don’t get lost!" "OK! " my dad cried back.
ex.t: “不要迟到吃晚饭，”保罗叔叔喊道， “保持轨道，这样你就不会迷路了！“好！ ”爸爸喊道。

ex.s: After a while Uncle Paul and his fam house were out of sight.
ex.t: 过了一段时间,保罗叔叔和他的家庭 房子被忽略了。
